messages.content: How many calories are in a tomato?

function.name: grocery_store_item_details

message.content:
A **medium-sized fresh tomato** (about 120–130 grams) contains roughly **20–25 kilocalories (kcal)**—the same as “Calories” you see on nutrition labels.  

| Tomato variety / size | Weight (approx.) | Calories |
|-----------------------|------------------|----------|
| Small cherry/peach   | 10 g              | ≈2 kcal |
| Medium round         | 125 g             | 21 kcal |
| Large Roma           | 150 g             | 27 kcal |

These numbers assume raw, unprocessed tomatoes. Cooking methods (e.g., roasting, sautéing) add minimal extra calories unless oil or other ingredients are added. If you’re tracking macros precisely, weigh your portion and multiply by the calorie density above.
